reason: Host-page contract: sidebar.css consumes this layout variable but annotation-workspace.html deliberately leaves it undeclared (dashboard.html gets it from dashboard.layout.css:5), so the mobile body padding / navbar height resolve to their initial values there. Declaring a sidebar.css :root default changes the workspace mobile layout (issue #1388 attempt broke RESP-01 and issue-928 at 390x844), so the entry stays.
